answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, clawed back after a replayed submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the pulse of a task receipt, and the gale is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the atlas of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
